## Summary

Describe the outcome and why it is needed.

## Verification

List commands or manual checks performed.

## Checklist

- [ ] Tests were added or updated for changed behavior.
- [ ] Local lint, type-check, build, and relevant tests pass.
- [ ] A Prisma migration is included if the database schema changed.
- [ ] README, ARCHITECTURE, CONTRIBUTING, or an ADR was updated if boundaries or conventions changed.
- [ ] No secrets, credentials, `.env` files, or personal data are committed.
- [ ] The change is scoped to one domain or concern.
